item.text:
Audited every Roman verse against the Urdu in `deke-awaaz-baap-ko.md`. Corrected phonetic spellings, nasal endings, izafat, and name capitalization. Removed the extra `kaise` from the penultimate Roman line to match the Urdu. Preserved the Urdu body and metadata.

The existing readings `Ayna ayna`, `Shabbir`, and `lab pe` still need editorial confirmation because the Urdu spellings are ambiguous or irregular. `git diff --check` passed.
